versions.title_at_revision: Verify that normal and emergency procedures are included in the flight manual and training curriculum for the air vehicle.
versions.text: Verify that normal and emergency procedures are included in the flight manual and training curriculum for the air vehicle. DoD/MIL Doc: Refer to technical point of contact for this discipline (listed in section A.2). FAA Doc: 14CFR references: 23.1581

Criterion: Verify that normal and emergency operating procedures, limitations, restrictions, servicing, and maintenance information are included in the flight and maintenance manuals and training curriculum. Standard: Engineering data, e.g., system parameters, normal and emergency operational limitations, and environmental control system maintenance requirements, have been developed as input to flight and maintenance manuals and the training curriculum. Flight manual addresses environmental control system normal and emergency procedures, warnings and cautions, and aircraft operating limitations. Maintenance manuals address environmental control system servicing and maintenance procedures. Method of Compliance: Review of flight and maintenance manuals and training curriculum verify that proper instructions are provided for procedures required to ensure safety of flight operations under both normal and emergency operation conditions. References: MIL-STD-38784 14 CFR 23.1581, 25.1581, 27.1581, 29.1581

Standard: Flight manuals, checklist, and other flight crew technical documents contain ECS normal and emergency procedures, operating modes, controls and displays, WCAs, restrictions and operating limitations, system descriptions, and other engineering data. Maintenance manuals contain ECS servicing, maintenance procedures, and component life limits. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review flight manuals to verify accuracy and completeness of ECS normal and emergency procedures, limitations, system descriptions, operating modes, controls and displays, WCAs, and other relevant engineering data.
(2) Review maintenance manuals to verify that manual(s) include inspections and safety-critical component life limits to address system design performance issues and incomplete qualification testing status. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct supporting analyses to establish the basis for published operating procedures, flight manual limits (e.g., emergency time to land in worst-case conditions), and system operating limits.
  (2) Conduct supporting analyses to establish the basis for published maintenance manual procedures, inspections, and component life limits due to incomplete qualification status, field inspection results, or field service deficiency reports. Test.
    (1) Ground test: Conduct ground test to validate and verify flight manual normal and emergency procedures. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
    (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to validate and verify flight manual normal and emergency procedures.
